text: Alex moves into a flat in Berlin, and Frau Schneider, the landlady, shows Alex the rooms. In this unit you will say where you live and with whom, describe a home, a room and its furniture, and understand a flat advert. The scenes are set in places you may know: the Language Centre, a student hall of residence, a flat viewing, a flat share and a furniture shop.
Listen to the dialogues first, then work through the other sections in any order.
